# CDL Entry Level Driver Training (ELDT): Class B to Class A Upgrade

> 12-hour online entry-level driver training (theory) for drivers who hold a Class B CDL and want to upgrade to Class A, in accordance with FMCSA and DOT regulations in 49 CFR Part 380. Offered by HAZWOPER OSHA Training (https://hazwoper-osha.com), listed on the FMCSA Training Provider Registry.

## Key facts
- Regulation: 49 CFR Part 380 (FMCSA ELDT rule, effective February 7, 2022: training before testing for a Class A upgrade)
- Duration: 12 hours; 5 modules, 22 lessons, final exam (80% to pass)
- Credits: 1.2 CEU
- Price: $129.99 per person; bulk pricing from 2 seats
- Delivery: 100% online, 24/7, mobile-friendly, audio playback
- Reporting: completion reported to the FMCSA Training Provider Registry
- Not included: behind-the-wheel training (complete separately with an approved provider if your state requires it)
- State acceptance: accepted in every state except Washington, which requires classroom instruction by a registered Washington training provider for drivers holding or obtaining a Washington CDL
- Typical prerequisites: age 18+ (21+ for interstate), valid Class B license, DOT physical and drug screen

## Modules
1. Basic Operation of a Commercial Motor Vehicle (inspections, shifting, backing, coupling and uncoupling)
2. Safe Operating Procedures
3. Advanced Operating Practices (hazard perception, skid control, railroad crossings)
4. Vehicle Systems and Reporting Malfunctions
5. Non-Driving Activities (hours of service, fatigue and wellness)
